title: Tessa Dick says Philip K. Dick believed the world was a simulation

tellings.quote: >> My friend RZ Verk um who's written uh you know a couple of books about simulation theory is friends with his wife >> uh Tessadick and she talks about how he was just fully bought into the world being a simulation. you know, it's like

plain: The science fiction writer Philip K. Dick was fully convinced that the world is a simulation, a kind of computer-made reality rather than a real one, according to his wife, Tessa Dick. Michels passes this on second-hand: his friend Rizwan Virk, who has written a couple of books about simulation theory, is friends with Tessa Dick, and she talks about how her husband was "just fully bought into the world being a simulation." If so, one of the writers most linked to that idea believed it about his own life, not just in his fiction.
